parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(i=>{const j=i.json||{}; const t=j.title||''; const parts=t.split(':'); return {json:{id:String(j.guid||j.link||t),title:(parts.length>1?parts.slice(1).join(':'):t).trim(),company:(parts.length>1?parts[0]:'').trim(),location:'Remote',jobType:'Remote',salary:'',tags:[],publishedAt:j.isoDate||j.pubDate||'',url:j.link||'',source:'WeWorkRemotely',description:j.contentSnippet||j.content||''}}});

const cfg=$('CONFIG - EDIT ME').first().json; const store=$getWorkflowStaticData('global'); if(!Array.isArray(store.sentJobKeys)) store.sentJobKeys=[]; const sent=new Set(store.sentJobKeys); const fresh=[]; for(const item of $input.all()){const j=item.json; const key=[j.title,j.company,j.url].join('|').toLowerCase(); if(!sent.has(key)){fresh.push(item); sent.add(key);}} store.sentJobKeys=Array.from(sent).slice(-Number(cfg.maxStoredJobKeys||5000)); return fresh;

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: $('CONFIG - EDIT ME').first().json.telegramChatId, text: $json.telegramMessage, parse_mode: 'HTML', disable_web_page_preview: true }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const p=$input.first().json||{}; const jobs=Array.isArray(p.jobs)?p.jobs:[]; return jobs.map(j=>{const loc=Array.isArray(j.locationRestrictions)&&j.locationRestrictions.length?j.locationRestrictions.map(x=>x.name||x.alpha2||x.slug).filter(Boolean).join(', '):'Worldwide / Remote'; const sal=(j.minSalary||j.maxSalary)?`${j.currency||''} ${j.minSalary||''}${j.minSalary&&j.maxSalary?' - ':''}${j.maxSalary||''} ${j.salaryPeriod||''}`.trim():''; return {json:{id:String(j.guid||j.applicationLink||j.title),title:j.title||'',company:j.companyName||'',location:loc,jobType:j.employmentType||'',salary:sal,tags:[...(Array.isArray(j.categories)?j.categories:[]),...(Array.isArray(j.parentCategories)?j.parentCategories:[]),...(Array.isArray(j.seniority)?j.seniority:[])],publishedAt:j.pubDate||'',url:j.applicationLink||'',source:'Himalayas',description:j.description||j.excerpt||''}}});
